question: Find female patients diagnosed with SLE who have at least one laboratory record showing a normal IgA level and elevated total bilirubin above 1.2. For each such patient, return their ID, sex, diagnosis, the number of distinct lab visits meeting these criteria, and the highest T-BIL value observed.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    T1."XCL_058" AS "ID",
    T1."XCL_059" AS "sex",
    T1."XCL_064" AS "diagnosis",
    COUNT(DISTINCT T2."XCL_015") AS "distinct_lab_visits",
    MAX(T2."XCL_037") AS "highest_T_BIL"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND T2."XCL_037" > 1.2
GROUP BY T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_059", T1."XCL_064"

SELECT
    p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
    p.XCL_059 AS sex,
    e.XCL_006 AS diagnosis,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.XCL_015) AS distinct_lab_visits,
    MAX(l.XCL_021) AS highest_tbil
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE
    p.XCL_059 = 'F'
    AND e.XCL_006 = 'SLE'
    AND l.XCL_020 = 1          -- IgA normal
    AND l.XCL_021 > 1.2        -- T-BIL elevated above 1.2
GROUP BY
    p.XCL_058,
    p.XCL_059,
    e.XCL_006
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.XCL_015) >= 1
